verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents managed lifecycle nodes (ros2-docs-5), which are the standard building block for implementing safety-interlock/state-transition patterns like emergency stop, plus QoS tuning (ros2-docs-14/22/41) and preliminary real-time support (ros2-docs-32) that engineers rely on for safety-critical control loops. However, there is no explicit documented emergency-stop tutorial, reference pattern, or safety-certification guidance in the evidence. Missing for 10: dedicated emergency-stop/safety-interlock tutorial or design guide, explicit safety-certification or functional-safety documentation, and independent confirmation that lifecycle nodes are used successfully for e-stop in production.
